purpose: Keep doing an action consistently through to the end.
keywords: I maintained my position to the end.
I kept watch all night without sleeping.
She kept her promise all the way through.
restrictions: Often emphasizes persistence despite difficulty, more than merely finishing an amount.
mistake: Use established action combinations; this suffix does not simply mean pass through a place.
